Name: Far Territory
Author: Jared
Description: Far Territory (early development) adds lands beyond the forest, reached by ordinary travel. Follow the river to the coast, then sail an outrigger canoe to a warm, snow-free island with a whole coast and interior to explore: a volcano, a shipwreck, an old ruin and sixteen caves, eight of them a chain of dark halls. Climb and fell coconut palms, gather tropical food, medicine, spice and fibre plants (all also grown in the base game's Garden Plot), fish every coast with any line, rod, net, spear or trap, and dive for shellfish. Fight island animals, watch for sharks, sea kraits and urchins, and butcher what you kill. A dugout canoe carries you down the river in one paddle. Beyond the forest lie a grassland with a moose, snowy mountains with a hot spring, rock salt and a Rope and Pitons cliff climb, and cold fjords with seals, walrus and puffins. Optional crossovers: Harsh Wilds, Forest Lore and Sirus23 Mod Collection. Requires CSFFModFramework 2.28.0 or later.
